content: rmcp StreamableHttpService mounts on axum router (e.g. /mcp on 127.0.0.1:port); service factory creates fresh server instance per session. Bearer-token auth done as axum middleware layer; official rust-sdk examples exist. Pattern of embedding in desktop app: spawn axum server on tokio runtime at app startup, graceful shutdown on app exit. Session management is built-in to StreamableHttpService.
